layers.message: Write reports as CSV with a header row
Record report guide context, scope, and design
Add report guide, final review, and synchronization findings
Document the --account filter in the report guide
Correct report output format in project context and scope

graderOnly: The corrected .standards/CONTEXT.md and tally/report.py show that tally report writes CSV: a header row account,entries,total, then one comma-separated row per account sorted by name with totals to two decimals. The existing design's Interfaces and Contracts still says one tab-separated line per account (account, total) with no header.

The scope was revised after the design was written: AC-002 (tab-separated output example) is retired and replaced by the new current AC-004 (output as the command writes it). The design's Acceptance Coverage and Technical Acceptance Criteria still list AC-002 and do not mention AC-004. Current ACs are AC-001, AC-003, AC-004.

The active recovery frame is Frame 3: Owner AUDITING, From and ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING, FailureType PROJECT_CONTEXT. Frames 1 and 2 are older frames (Owner DOCUMENTING with RerunThrough REVIEWING_FINAL; Owner SYNCHRONIZING with RerunThrough NONE) and must stay unchanged; Architect owns none of them.

The expected outcome is a revised design covering AC-001, AC-003, and AC-004 from current source and context, then a FORWARD handoff from ARCHITECTING to DOCUMENTING with all three frames kept. No development plan, verification report, or implementation review belongs in this cycle, and the design needs no Build Plan.
README.md and docs/reports.md still describe tab-separated output; correcting them is Documenter's later rerun work, not Architect's.
